regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, introduction, author block, and SI statement
regions.finding: The actual article title is 'Asymmetric Construction of Six-Membered Rings by Cyclization of Allenes with Dinuclear Gold Catalysis'. The abstract is aggregate current-work context. The paper states that SI is available online, but workspace association remains unestablished and no SI-only fact was imported.

regions.region: page 1 right-column optimization prose referring to SI Table S1
regions.finding: The main text explicitly restates five [AuCl(PPh3)]/silver-salt/solvent outcomes (91%, 99%, 98%, 0%, 93%) and two qualitative alternative-catalyst results. They are retained as seven partial optimization records; unprinted SI row details remain missing, and 'failed to afford better results' is not converted to zero.

regions.region: page 1 lower-right Table 1 reaction header, six displayed products, and footnote
regions.finding: Six independent racemic scope experiments were read from the original image with shared 2 (0.2 mmol), [AuCl(PPh3)] 5 mol%, AgOTf 5 mol%, dioxane 2 mL, room temperature, 24 h conditions and product yields 94%, 90%, 85%, 81%, 70%, and 87%.

unresolved: The cited SI Tables S1/Scheme S1 are not associated; only values explicitly repeated in the main text were used.
Table 1 does not state yield basis, atmosphere, workup, purification, or product masses.

regions.region: page 2 left-column optimization prose referring to SI Table S2
regions.finding: Six explicitly described conditions were retained: [AuCl(PPh3)]/AgOTf in dioxane (97%, 55% ee), its toluene solvent result (70% ee), IPrAuCl result (15% ee), dinuclear dppm result (98%, 97% ee), and the two missing-component no-reaction controls. Unnamed silver-salt rows were not fabricated.

Five independent enantioenriched substrate-scope rows were retained. Entry 2 is a separate 4.0 mmol/1.0245 g/40 mL/36 h repeat, not merged with entry 1. Entry 1 is linked to the detailed page-4 experiment.
S_a-2a (99% ee) undergoes the dinuclear-gold cyclization in toluene at room temperature for 24 h to S-3a in 91% yield and 97% ee; this opposite-enantiomer run is separate from R_a-2a experiments.

Seven independent aryl-scope experiments R-3e/R-3f/R-3g/R-3h/R-3i/S-3j/S-3k were read row-by-row with their printed 28–48 h times, 81–95% yields, and 94–>98% ee values under the shared 1.0 mmol conditions.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right Equation 2 and X-ray statement
regions.finding: R_a-2l (97% ee) gives R-3l in 92% yield and rounded 98% ee after 48 h. It is the same experiment as Table 4 entry 5 and is merged with the exact 97.7% ee table value rather than duplicated.

unresolved: SI Table S2 itself is not associated; unprinted row quantities/times and unnamed silver salts were not inferred.
Table 3 omits starting ee and analytical bases.
Most scope rows omit atmosphere, workup, purification, and product mass.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Table 4 reaction header, entries 1–5, and footnotes
regions.finding: Five ligand-effect conditions were reconciled. Entries 1–4 remain distinct 0.2 mmol/5 mol% catalyst/AgOTf/toluene experiments with isolated yields, chiral-HPLC ee, and cone-angle source values. Entry 5 is merged with page-2 Equation 2; the 97.7% and rounded 98% ee values are both preserved.
A distinct PhBr preparative run converts 2l to 3l at room temperature for 14 h using 2.5 mol% dppm gold and 5 mol% AgOTf, giving 96% NMR yield.

Three independent ESI-MS experiments were retained: solution A anion exchange (0.005/0.01 mmol, 10 min), solution B stoichiometric allene/gold/AgOTf (0.05/0.05/0.10 mmol, 10 min), and solution C catalytic reaction (0.20/0.005/0.01 mmol, 8 h), including filtration/dilution and all explicitly detected ions.

unresolved: ESI-MS assignments are source interpretations and do not establish isolated intermediates or yields.
Filtration medium and absolute dilution volumes are not reported.
Table 4 omits starting-material ee and product masses.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left Scheme 1 and mechanism prose
regions.finding: IM1–IM3 and the anti-attack/rearomatization/protodemetalation sequence are explicitly proposed mechanistic rationale and are classified as one mechanism record, not preparations of the intermediates.

regions.region: page 4 lower-left Experimental Section for R-3a
regions.finding: The exact 1.0 mmol R_a-2a preparation matches Table 2 entry 1 and was merged into that record, adding sequential glove-box charging, dry Schlenk/N2 operation, 24 h at room temperature, TLC, Et2O/silica workup, petroleum-ether chromatography, 233.8 mg, 91% isolated yield, 99% ee, and HPLC details. The nominal 2.5 mol% versus 0.026 mmol catalyst charge is retained as a source rounding discrepancy.

Tao Cao is thanked for reproducing Table 1 entry 2, Table 2 entry 4, and Table 3 entry 3. No independent conditions or outcomes are supplied, so the statements support existing records without creating duplicate experiments. Remaining text is bibliography/characterization.

unresolved: The detailed catalyst charge is 0.026 mmol at 1.0 mmol substrate, while Table 2 reports 2.5 mol%; both are preserved for review.
Mechanistic intermediates remain proposed and machine-unverified.

regions.finding: The page is bibliography and prior-literature context; cited papers were not expanded into experiments of the current article.

regions.region: page 5 footnote 11 crystallographic data/CCDC statement for R-3l
regions.finding: Crystal data characterize R-3l and support the existing Equation 2/Table 4 entry 5 assignment. They are not a separate preparation, do not verify the machine SMILES, and the CCDC deposition is not treated as associated Supporting Information.

regions.region: page 5 publication dates and remaining blank area
regions.finding: Publication metadata and blank page area contain no additional reaction arrow, table row, procedure, failure result, or experimental outcome.
